questions.q: In "Understand display technologies and uses Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Interview buyers in three settings, such as grocery, transit and shop windows, and write down each one's viewing distance and hours of use per day.

questions.q: In "Know product and trade rules Apply", which of these is a key idea?
